notes.random: It is compared with 200 random-entry runs at its own time in market: random intraday trades, never overlapping and closed by the session's last bar, with lengths drawn from that strategy's own trades and the same share of longs, paying the same costs.
notes.val: Not a clean test. This strategy was picked from the cb_nr_rty_v4_15m finalists using their 2023–2024 results (Sharpe, beats-luck, overlap with each other) as well as 2018–2022, and the grid itself was chosen after reading round 1 on 2023–2024, so 2023–2024 is in-sample for the choice. It shows the strategies held up; it can't prove it. The untouched test is the 2025+ holdout tab.
notes.holdout: First NR-N look at the RTY holdout. No NR-N strategy had been scored on RTY 2025 onward before this run (apart from the final-test of these same frozen picks), and only this one, frozen beforehand, was run, so there's no selection among holdout results. The sibling BB/KC squeeze line was scored on RTY 2025+ before. The mean-reversion and noise-band families were scored on RTY 2025+ earlier (different strategies; the noise-band pair lost), so the researcher has seen how that period treated them.

legs.settings_text: 15m bars, NR-3, at least 1 NR bar(s), NR bar range at most 0.5 ATR, wick entry, setup live 1 bar(s), 1.0-ATR stop, 2R target, long + short, no trend filter, any box width, flat at the close
